text.en: Pet owners speak with immense gratitude about lead trainer Russell Hartstein, describing him as extraordinarily knowledgeable, supportive, and kind. Clients praise his positive-reinforcement philosophy and appreciate how thoroughly he educates entire households on canine psychology.

Reviewers report profound transformations in severe canine behaviors, including reactivity, resource guarding, separation anxiety, and acclimating dogs to newborn babies. Clients emphasize that bootcamps and consultations yield reliable, lasting progress in real-world settings.

Clients consistently emphasize the outstanding quality of communication throughout training programs. Russell provides detailed daily written logs, uploaded photos and videos with expert commentary, and links to science-backed research that empower owners to continue training at home.

q.en: Does the trainer provide daily progress updates?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently highlight receiving comprehensive daily written reports, videos, and photos with commentary during bootcamp stays.

q.en: Can the trainer help acclimate dogs to newborn infants?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report successful desensitization and obedience preparation to help anxious dogs safely adjust to new babies at home.

q.en: Does the service address severe reactivity between pets?

a.en: Yes, clients praise Russell's guidance in carefully managing prey drive and integrating reactive dogs with household cats and other canines.

q.en: Are training methods based on positive reinforcement?

a.en: Yes, pet parents emphasize his force-free approach grounded in behavioral science, positive reinforcement, and family education.
